accounts.name: destination
docs: The wallet being bound; its signature is the contributor's acceptance of this exact binding.

accounts.name: fee_account
docs: Any token account of the mint that the fee recipient owns.

instructions.name: commit_bounty
docs: Bounties reuse ordinary reserves, destination authorization and recovery, in a
bounty-purpose project only.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone; pays the period account's rent.

accounts.name: month
docs: One per project and period, so a period commits once.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone; pays the award accounts' rent.

accounts.name: settled
docs: Exists once per source in a month, so a committed award cannot also be released.

accounts.name: monthly_source
docs: Records that a monthly award consumed this source, so the same source in another
month can be released.

accounts.name: project
docs: One project per owner, project ID and purpose, so ordinary awards and private bounties
never share a vault.

accounts.name: mint
docs: Classic SPL or the approved metadata-only Token-2022 subset.

instructions.name: initialize_native
docs: SOL stays in a program-owned vault, never a wrapped token account. The asset sentinel
occupies the existing immutable mint field, so existing Project layouts are unchanged.

accounts.name: destination
docs: The handler requires this to be the associated token account of whichever binding pays.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone; pays the settlement marker's rent.

accounts.name: monthly_source
docs: recorded obligation decides); it stays so the instruction's accounts are unchanged.

accounts.name: obligation
docs: The obligation the origin records; required unless the actor is zero.

accounts.name: settled
docs: The same marker as commit_monthly_award, so a source settles once per month.

accounts.name: obligation
docs: An unpaid award to this actor in this project whose commit delay has not passed;
it extends the veto window to that award's commit delay.

types.name: AllocationNode
docs: Each sibling authenticates both its digest and aggregate gross amount.

types.name: Config
docs: The separate identity, fee and rotation authorities, written once by
`initialize_config` and never changed.

types.name: MonthlyAllocation
docs: One period's recorded allocation root and the gross committed from it so far.

fields.name: committed
docs: Gross settled so far: committed awards plus released awards.

fields.name: released
docs: The part of `committed` that release_monthly_award or release_monthly_reserve returned
to free balance. This
field also makes the account larger than the 92-byte month of the 316-byte build (no
settled markers or outstanding count), so such a month fails closed here.

fields.name: frozen_at
docs: When the attester froze the allocation. Only a source consumed by hand before it can
be released.

fields.name: expired
docs: Legacy layout field. New funded months never expire.

fields.name: monthly_cap
docs: The most a period's monthly awards may commit in gross, and whether anyone may record
and commit them. Only the owner sets them.

fields.name: accrued_fees
docs: Payout and withdrawal fees held in the vault until claim_fees moves them.

fields.name: monthly_outstanding
docs: Gross of admitted monthly allocations not yet committed or released. While it is
positive the owner cannot commit by hand.

types.name: Purpose
docs: What a project holds funds for. It is part of the project PDA seeds.

types.name: WalletBinding
docs: One binding per project and actor, so each project's delay, vetoes and payments are
its own. The first seven fields are the latest binding, the only one that can pay.

fields.name: paid_version
docs: The version the last payment in this project used; 0 before the first payment.

fields.name: veto_count
docs: Vetoes recorded since the last payment in this project.
